bathAction.title: Shower head
bathAction.tooltip: Take the shower head down and spray what the hands cannot reach. Half a minute.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(lift)] the shower head off its hook and [npc.verb(test)] the spray against [npc.her] hand, then [npc.verb(angle)] it toward the parts [npc.she] cannot easily reach. [npc.speech(The head comes off. That solves the rest.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(pull)] the shower head down and [npc.verb(turn)] the spray on [npc.herHim], grinning when the hot water hits somewhere [npc.her] hands had been missing. [npc.speech(Oh, that reaches. Keep it there.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(yank)] the shower head off the hook and [npc.verb(aim)] it, ready to spray the awkward parts and be done. [npc.speech(Use the head. I am not twisting around.)]
